sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Embed, Rerank, and Parse: Advancing Agents with ...
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Rerank uses the same backbone architecture as Nemotron-3.5-Embed-8B in a cross-encoder configuration. While the embedding model encodes queries and documents separately and scores their similarity, the reranker jointly encodes each query–document pair.

sources.title: nemotron-3.5-rerank-8b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B-BF16 was developed by NVIDIA for multilingual and multimodal question-answering retrieval. It is a world-class reranker optimized to produce a logit representing the relevance of a document to a text query.
